usedFor: Shopify takes the orders and Paddle holds billing customers, so “New Order” can register the buyer with “Create Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Create Customer” in Paddle
bestTemplate.why: Each order creates its buyer as a Paddle customer, which the address and business actions then build on.

watchOut: “Create an Address” and “Create a Business” belong to an existing Paddle customer, so run “Create Customer” first.
